title: Te Karere i Tū atu ki te hunga karakia whakapakoko
intro: I te wā i ngaro ai te aroha, ka ara ake tētahi karere me te karanga kia hoki ki te karakia ki te Ariki o ngā ao. I tū pakari tēnei tangata ki te aroaro o tētahi iwi kua mau tonu ki te karakia ki tētahi atua teka, hei whakamahara i a rātou ki tō rātou Kaihanga pono me te Ariki o ō rātou tūpuna. Heoi, i mangere te iwi, ā, i whakakahore i te whakatūpato, ā, i hiritia ai tō rātou ake aituā. Ko wai tēnei kaikaranga kore e mutu?
clues: I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi kua tahuri ke i te ara o te Atua Pono Kotahi.
I pātai atu ahau ki tōku iwi, "Kāore ianei koutou e wehi i a Allah?"
I karanga ahau i a rātou kia whakarērea tā rātou karakia ki tētahi atua teka, ko Paara tōna ingoa.
I whakakahore taku iwi i taku karanga, ā, i tohe tonu ki tā rātou karakia whakapakoko.
Nā tā rātou whakakahore, ka tino arahina rātou kia whiua.
I homai e tōku Ariki te rangimārie ki ahau, me te maumaharatanga manaakitanga i roto i ngā whakatupuranga o muri mai.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I karanga ia i tōna iwi kia whakarērea a Paara
I hanga e ia he āaka hei whakaora i te hunga whakapono
I maka ki roto i te ahi
I rere atu i te Parao nanakia
I patu i te toka kia puta mai ai te wai
trial.answer: I karanga ia i tōna iwi kia whakarērea a Paara

outcome.label: Hua
options: I homai he rangimārie, he maharatanga manaaki
I whakangaromia e te tupuhi nanakia
outcome.answer: I homai he rangimārie, he maharatanga manaaki

verse: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers, (37:123)
